nodes.label: Notification-first PWA decision
nodes.rationale: No next-pwa plugin: service worker only handles push, so ~40 lines beat a plugin. Push is free, keeping email volume and Resend quota low.

nodes.label: Permission-filtered navigation (visibleNav)

nodes.label: Agent history entry JSON contract (schema.json)
nodes.rationale: Task list says what should happen, git says which lines changed; neither records intent, verification and decisions. additionalProperties false so drift fails validation.

nodes.label: Agent history vs agent memory
nodes.rationale: History is reviewed, schema-validated and shared via git; memory is unreviewed hints and cannot override the contract.

nodes.label: One file per session, append-only entries
nodes.norm_label: one file per session, append-only entries
nodes.rationale: Per-session files avoid merge conflicts across parallel branches and agents; corrections via supersedes.

nodes.label: One-way rule (sources to obsidian-out, read-only)
nodes.rationale: Letting Kanban plugin write back would create a second writer rewriting the whole task file on every drag and cause merge conflicts with agent branches.
